_why_beta: 5y regression beta 0.24 is unrepresentative of underwriting-cycle risk; use P&C industry beta ~0.80

dcf._why: Revenue = premiums earned + investment income. 'EBIT margin' = pre-tax margin: TTM 16.6% is a cycle peak (combined ratio ~87); fades to 10.5%, roughly PGR's through-cycle average and consistent with its 96 combined-ratio target plus ~4-5% investment margin. Growth slows in the soft market then normalises. Reinvestment = statutory capital needed at ~3:1 premium-to-surplus, i.e. 30% of each new revenue dollar.

ddm._why: PGR pays a small fixed quarterly dividend plus a large variable annual dividend from excess capital; D0 = 3-yr average total DPS (FY23-25) to normalise lumpy specials

_why_rule1_growth: Data-driven windage hits the 15% cap; consensus has EPS falling in 2026-27 (soft market). Use 12% = below 10y BVPS growth (15.3%) and 5y BVPS growth (12.2%).
